profiles.label: Adaptive Surface
profiles.typeCeiling: hold display type until real content, object, or narrative earns it
profiles.layout: one primary object or task, one clear action, and a responsive content path; defer a domain template until evidence exists
profiles.anchor: the real object, content, or workflow supplied by the brief
profiles.signatureMove: let content density and object importance determine composition instead of preselecting a genre
avoid: premature dashboard, commerce, or editorial template

profiles.label: Productive App UI
profiles.typeCeiling: compact page title; no display role by default
profiles.layout: task-first workspace, split pane, or grouped settings rows
profiles.anchor: active work item, table, preview, or selected detail
profiles.signatureMove: density contrast between the action region and the inspected object

profiles.label: Creative Editor
profiles.typeCeiling: compact tool labels; display type belongs to the edited media, not the chrome
profiles.layout: media canvas with tool rail, context controls, and undoable adjustments
profiles.anchor: real image, canvas, crop, or edit preview
profiles.signatureMove: selection, preview, and adjustment controls stay anchored to the edited object
avoid: desktop toolbar collapsed without touch plan

profiles.label: Command / Builder Tool
profiles.typeCeiling: compact title with restrained mono for code, ids, and shortcuts
profiles.layout: tool rail, work canvas, inspector, and command surface
profiles.anchor: canvas, selected object, or command result
profiles.signatureMove: selection, preview, and inspector move as one object

profiles.label: Data Workbench
profiles.typeCeiling: compact labels and tabular numbers; large numbers only for the primary object
profiles.layout: filter bar, table/chart relationship, selected-row detail
profiles.anchor: data object, chart, table, or live status
profiles.signatureMove: filtering preserves row identity and keeps the detail context stable

profiles.label: Commerce / Transaction Flow
profiles.typeCeiling: product title and price can lead; keep utility copy compact
profiles.layout: browse, compare, inspect, and confirm with persistent product context
profiles.anchor: real product image, variant, price, or order state
profiles.signatureMove: product identity persists between list, detail, and cart/confirm states

profiles.label: Hardware Product Story
profiles.typeCeiling: product name or earned chapter title may lead; specs and controls stay compact
profiles.layout: product-object hero, feature chapters, material/performance proof, comparison, and buy path
profiles.anchor: real product object, material detail, configuration, or use context
profiles.signatureMove: one product promise per chapter, with the object remaining identifiable as proof accumulates
avoid: cinematic scroll that hides specs or purchase actions

profiles.label: Editorial Marketing
profiles.typeCeiling: display type allowed only when copy and media earn it
profiles.layout: narrative sections with one clear visual anchor and proof early
profiles.anchor: real product, person, place, or authored media
profiles.signatureMove: type, crop, and proof media establish a deliberate reading rhythm

profiles.label: Creator / Portfolio Studio
profiles.typeCeiling: identity-scale type only when real work appears early
profiles.anchor: real project media or authored object
profiles.signatureMove: project proof appears before claims and carries the page rhythm
avoid: same card repeated for every project

profiles.label: Media / Realtime Experience
profiles.typeCeiling: media object may lead; controls and status stay compact
profiles.layout: primary media surface with queue, state, and supporting controls
profiles.anchor: playback object, waveform, conversation, or live state
profiles.signatureMove: playback, queue, and status share one readable state rhythm

profiles.label: Spatial / Product Object
profiles.typeCeiling: labels and controls remain usable around the object
profiles.layout: staged object with inspection controls and clear fallback
profiles.anchor: real model, product object, or spatial data
profiles.signatureMove: camera, object state, and supporting information stay spatially related
avoid: model without fallback or camera discipline
